events.body: 6e7d5ddff3bf7217ff3c72457ec8f260ea1b5c07 - remove commit f3be683dcf80c7b6bb5eded6225923f6e00a1c11 per @Sjors suggestion and squash.

@maflcko, I think it is worth while to maintain this gui implementation until an "official" sun setting is announced. It has been a while since I have checked out the QML progress - I am sure it is progressing - but I don't anticipate the QML gui being merged until the [full modularization and separation ](https://github.com/orgs/bitcoin/projects/8) of the gui all together. **There are concerns related to the proper "sandboxing" of the Qt QML engine.**

> It has been a while since I have checked out the QML progress - I am sure it is progressing - but I don't anticipate the QML gui being merged until the [full modularization and separation ](https://github.com/orgs/bitcoin/projects/8) of the gui all together.

Same, but IIUC there was a recent update on the QML progress (check the last IRC meeting). So the QML gui may be available in 33.x. Even if it only makes it only later (e.g. 34.x), I still think the current gui should be frozen. This isn't a regression here, so just leaving this unfixed shouldn't make anything worse.

I mostly think if the QML gui is planned, all efforts should move toward that. Spending more time on the old gui will just delay the new gui.

If you think the new gui should not happen, or if you think there are weak spots, it would be good to raise those points or better: fix them.

@maflcko 

I actually stood down - I wanted to see what all those grant dollars would produce...

I am terribly disappointed...

Maybe somebody that gets paid to work on the qml gui can take this up...

https://github.com/bitcoin-core/gui-qml/pull/1055

> I think it is worth while to maintain this gui implementation until an "official" sun setting is announced.

I actually don't disagree with this. I think it's worthwhile to fix things like this. I will never tell someone they shouldn't improve a piece of software. However, even with agents we still have limited attention to give.

>It has been a while since I have checked out the QML progress - I am sure it is progressing - but I don't anticipate the QML gui being merged until the https://github.com/orgs/bitcoin/projects/8of the gui all together.

Full separation is already largely complete either through the multiprocess ipc or at buildtime. `bitcoind` guix build never sees the dependencies required for `bitcoin-qt`. So if you don't want any qt, run `bitcoind`.

> I am terribly disappointed...

Make the world better. Submit PRs.

> Maybe somebody that gets paid to work on the qml gui can take this up...

Get out of here with this. gui-qml received grant funding a couple of years ago and it was extremely helpful in bootstrapping the foundations, but I'm not aware of anyone currently with a grant to work directly on gui-qml. Despite that, it is significantly progressing and seeing more contributors than ever.

> https://github.com/bitcoin-core/gui-qml/pull/1055

Thank you for contributing. I will take a look.
